# app/controllers/api/v1/archives_controller.rb
require 'zip'
require 'fileutils'

module Api
  module V1
    class ArchivesController < ApplicationController
      before_action :authenticate_api_key!
      before_action :validate_content_type, only: [:upload]

      UPLOAD_DIR = Rails.root.join('tmp', 'uploads')
      EXTRACT_DIR = Rails.root.join('storage', 'extracted')
      MAX_FILE_SIZE = 50.megabytes
      ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS = %w[.txt .csv .json .xml .pdf .png .jpg].freeze

      def upload
        unless params[:file].present?
          return render json: { error: 'No file provided' }, status: :unprocessable_entity
        end

        uploaded_file = params[:file]
        
        if uploaded_file.size > MAX_FILE_SIZE
          return render json: { error: 'File too large' }, status: :payload_too_large
        end

        archive_path = save_uploaded_file(uploaded_file)
        extracted_files = extract_archive(archive_path)

        render json: {
          message: 'Archive processed successfully',
          files_extracted: extracted_files.length,
          filenames: extracted_files.map { |f| File.basename(f) }
        }, status: :ok
      rescue Zip::Error => e
        render json: { error: "Invalid archive: #{e.message}" }, status: :unprocessable_entity
      rescue StandardError => e
        Rails.logger.error("Archive processing failed: #{e.message}")
        render json: { error: 'Processing failed' }, status: :internal_server_error
      ensure
        FileUtils.rm_f(archive_path) if archive_path
      end

      private

      def authenticate_api_key!
        api_key = request.headers['X-API-Key']
        unless api_key.present? && ApiKey.active.exists?(key_digest: Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(api_key))
          render json: { error: 'Unauthorized' }, status: :unauthorized
        end
      end

      def validate_content_type
        unless request.content_type&.include?('multipart/form-data')
          render json: { error: 'Content-Type must be multipart/form-data' }, status: :unsupported_media_type
        end
      end

      def save_uploaded_file(file)
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(UPLOAD_DIR)
        path = UPLOAD_DIR.join("#{SecureRandom.uuid}.zip")
        File.open(path, 'wb') { |f| f.write(file.read) }
        path.to_s
      end

      def extract_archive(archive_path)
        extracted = []
        session_dir = EXTRACT_DIR.join(SecureRandom.uuid)
        FileUtils.mkdir_p(session_dir)

        Zip::File.open(archive_path) do |zip_file|
          zip_file.each do |entry|
            # Skip directories
            next if entry.directory?

            # Check file extension
            ext = File.extname(entry.name).downcase
            unless ALLOWED_EXTENSIONS.include?(ext)
              Rails.logger.warn("Skipping disallowed extension: #{entry.name}")
              next
            end

            # Check for null bytes in filename
            if entry.name.include?("\x00")
              Rails.logger.warn("Null byte in filename, skipping: #{entry.name}")
              next
            end

            # Construct destination path - NOTE: uses entry.name directly
            dest_path = File.join(session_dir.to_s, entry.name)
            
            # Ensure parent directory exists
            FileUtils.mkdir_p(File.dirname(dest_path))

            # Extract file
            entry.extract(dest_path)
            extracted << dest_path
          end
        end

        extracted
      end
    end
  end
end

Service is fronted by a Network Load Balancer registered as an AWS PrivateLink endpoint service (com.amazonaws.vpce.us-east-1.vpce-svc-0a1b2c3d4e5f67890). Consumer access requires VPC endpoint interface creation with explicit principal allowlisting via the endpoint service's allowed-principals list. The NLB has no public-facing listener; its scheme is 'internal'. Route tables for the private subnets contain only local VPC routes and VPC endpoint routes (no 0.0.0.0/0 route). Security groups on the Fargate ENIs restrict ingress to the NLB security group only (sg-0fedcba987654321) on port 8080. The ECS task role (arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/archive-svc-task-role) has no S3, SSM, or external service permissions. Fargate tasks use a read-only root filesystem with tmpfs mounts at /tmp (size 512MB, noexec) and an EFS access point mounted at /storage/extracted with a POSIX UID/GID-restricted path (/extracted/{session_id}) enforced by the access point's root directory creation info.
